# SpikeDrivenDetectionBackbone

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neural network architecture that serves as the feature extraction and object detection front-end for the tracker, converting visual input into spike-based representations. Establishes that spike-based backbones can support high-level vision tasks, a key building block for end-to-end neuromorphic perception systems.
